checks: Commerce opens the inquiry desk and explicit showcase link without a network call to a private inbox.
Import reads and escapes a genuine hashed export; preview shows source contact without creating a project.
Confirmation creates one technical dossier; contacts and source prose leave the DOM and never enter the journal.
Unknown height stays empty through the editable brief; central decision opens qualification and the quote requires operator-entered costs.
Reimport opens the existing dossier without duplicating or replacing working notes.
A revised export with the same reference displays a conflict and disables creation.
Closing an asynchronous read discards its later result and clears the source preview.
Dedicated inquiry tab displays the local technical list; CSS parses and no JavaScript error is raised.
scope: Real app and store in JSDOM, hashed JSON fixture, localStorage and user actions. No screen rendering, D1 account, contact message or payment.
